'''Law and crime'''
*''[[Trump v. Anderson]]''
**The [[US Supreme Court]] unanimously overturns the [[Colorado Supreme Court]] ruling removing former [[President of the United States|US President]] [[Donald Trump]] from the [[Colorado]] presidential primary ballot, based on the lack of authority of states to enforce [[Fourteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution#Section 3: Disqualification from office for insurrection or rebellion|Section 3 of the 14th Amendment of the United States Constitution]] "against federal officeholders and candidates". [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2024/03/04/us/trump-supreme-court-colorado-ballot (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Argentina|Argentine]] state news agency [[Télam]] is closed after 80 years and police surround its offices in [[Buenos Aires]] a week after [[President of Argentina|president]] [[Javier Milei]] threatened to close the agency. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentine-state-news-agency-telam-shut-after-milei-threat-2024-03-04/ (Reuters)]
